Context: None

Question: A 1,500-kw six-phase synchronous converter has a full-load d-c voltage of 600. Determines (a) the a-c voltage between rings; (b) the d-c output; (c) the a-c input per line.

Options: 
A. (a) 175 volts, (b) 3,500 amp, (c) 1,750 amp
B. (a) 289 volts, (b) 2,750 amp, (c) 1,375 amp
C. (a) 300 volts, (b) 2,000 amp, (c) 1,000 amp
D. (a) 100 volts, (b) 1,500 amp, (c) 800 amp
E. (a) 250 volts, (b) 3,250 amp, (c) 1,625 amp
F. (a) 212.4 volts, (b) 2,500 amp, (c) 1,180 amp
G. (a) 346.4 volts, (b) 2,200 amp, (c) 1,200 amp
H. (a) 415 volts, (b) 1,800 amp, (c) 900 amp
I. (a) 480 volts, (b) 1,250 amp, (c) 625 amp
J. (a) 400 volts, (b) 3,000 amp, (c) 1,500 amp

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.

    *   For a six-phase star-connected system (which is standard for rotary converters), the relationship between the DC output voltage and the AC line-to-neutral voltage (voltage between rings if neutral is center, or phase voltage) is often derived from the rectification theory.

    *   $V_{dc} = \frac{6}{2\pi} \int_{\pi/6}^{5\pi/6} V_m \sin(\theta) d\theta = \frac{3}{\pi} V_m [\cos(\pi/6) - \cos(5\pi/6)] = \frac{3}{\pi} V_m [\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - (-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})] = \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{\pi} V_m$.
